'''Girik''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Rathari]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Girik and his master were operating on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Under his master's order, Girik was negotiating with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] [[Ybann]] and [[Qiltakka]], who were representing the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]],<ref name="Disrupt Negotiations" /> when he was interrupted by the arrival of [[Darth Baras]]' [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]]. The Hutts promised to bow to the strongest side and Girik challenged the [[Sith Warrior]] in a duel, but was defeated.

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Warrior could choose to kill Girik for Dark Side points or spare him for Light Side points. If the Sith Warrior chooses to spare his life, he will kill himself with his own lightsaber.
